pages.text: Compared to armors that can be made from resources found in the world, the Sinner's Robe made from Risus-related materials holds far more potential. On top of decent defensive abilities and a health boosting feature, each piece of the set can have its own 'Ability'. For example, an ability all pieces can have (if a $(l:blocks/bondknot)$(c)$(o)Bondknot Log$() is inserted) is to summon a Great Stool below the wearer.

Making the pieces of the Sinner's Robe is an involved process. First, a full set of $(l:armors/skin_armor)$(c)$(o)Skin Armor$() is needed. After that, four $(l:materials/gluttonous_scales)$(c)$(o)Gluttonous Scales$() are used for each piece, totaling sixteen. Finally, one Stitching Needle is required per piece.
This armor can be dyed and trimmed. These aesthetic effects will appear alongside the abilities' visuals.
A Cauldron of Water will remove the dye applied.
